identification: Six 1960s-70s portable transistor/AM radios: two Astor 7-transistor AM portables with metal/silver grille (one in black leather case, nearly identical models), Rambler transistor in leather case, National Panasonic portable in leather case (leather worn), Premium CB/AM 'all channel CB receiver AM band' handheld (grey), and a black AM portable with chrome trim (brand badge illegible, looks like an Arrow/ARC-type tab-top set).
